{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent history shows persistent downward drift and model fails to mean-revert.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00) to avoid underestimating rebounds.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast 3-5 days prior, adjust current forecast downward by 5-15%.",
    "Cap forecast spikes above 10% above recent 7-day high — avoid overshoots in bullish sentiment periods.",
    "When sentiment is positive and forecast is below true outcome, increase forecast by 3-8% to capture momentum.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below 3-day moving average of forecast, apply mean-reversion bias: add 2-5% to forecast to align with trend.",
    "For sentiment = 0.00, use 30-day historical mean as baseline and adjust ±2% based on volatility of last 5 days."
  ]
}
